# StoatPlot

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Pa-Tou/stoat_plot/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Pa-Tou/stoat_plot/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/Pa-Tou/stoat_plot/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/Pa-Tou/stoat_plot)
[![Docker Repository on
Quay](https://quay.io/repository/patou/stoat_plot/status "Docker Repository on Quay")](https://quay.io/repository/patou/stoat_plot)

## Overview

`StoatPlot` provides a set of lightweight and user-friendly tools for
visualizing **GWAS results** generated by the [**STOAT**
tool](https://github.com/pa-tou/stoat). It includes functions for
generating:

- **Manhattan plots**
- **Q-Q plots**
- **P-value histograms**
- **Genotype-based boxplots**
- **Paths length distribution**
- **Snarl type histogram**

These tools facilitate the visual inspection of association signals and
support downstream interpretation of GWAS outputs.

## Installation

``` r

# Install from GitHub
# install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("Pa-Tou/stoat_plot")
```

> If you are having problem, another option is to follow the
> [`install.R`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/install.R) script
> (used to install the package in the Docker container). This script is
> supposed to be run from the root of this folder, so you would have
> clone the repo first.

## Functions

### Visualization Function

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`summary_stoat()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/summary_stoat.md) | Print summary information on GWAS results |
| [`manhattan_plot()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/manhattan_plot.md) | Manhattan plot for GWAS results |
| [`qq_plot()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/qq_plot.md) | Q-Q plot for p-values |
| [`plot_pvalue_hist()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/plot_pvalue_hist.md) | Histogram of p-values from GWAS |
| [`genotype_boxplots()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/genotype_boxplots.md) | Boxplots of phenotype values by genotype |
| [`path_length_distribution()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/path_length_distribution_all.md) | Dot Plot of Path Length Frequencies |
| [`snarl_type_histogram()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/snarl_type_histogram.md) | Dot Plot of snarl type histogram |

## Usage

See the vignettes for examples on how to use it:

- *Soon*

A minimal example, to plot the QQ-plot and Manhattan plot, would look
like this:

``` r

assoc = import_assoc('stoat_output/stoat.assoc.pvalues.tsv.gz')
qq_plot(assoc)
manhattan_plot(assoc)
```

## Sorting and indexing snarl genotypes

To speed up the visualization of associations,
[`genotype_boxplots()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/genotype_boxplots.md)
extracts the relevant genotypes from an indexed and bgzipped TSV file.
To index a `snarl_genotypes.tsv.gz` (output of `stoat vcf` or
`stoat graph`) with `bgzip` and `tabix`:

``` sh
(zcat snarl_genotypes.tsv.gz | head -10000 | grep "^#"; zgrep -v "^#" snarl_genotypes.tsv.gz | sort -k3,3n -k4,4n -k5,5n) | bgzip > snarl_genotypes.sorted.tsv.gz
tabix -f -c "#" -s 3 -b 4 -e 5 snarl_genotypes.sorted.tsv.gz
```

You can then use the `snarl_genotypes.sorted.tsv.gz` file as input to
the `genotype_boxplots` function (*genotype_file* parameter).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`combine_chunk_phenotype_covars()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/combine_chunk_phenotype_covars.md)
  : Combine the allele counts for snarl with phenotype and covariables
- [`genotype_boxplots()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/genotype_boxplots.md)
  : Genotype vs phenotype boxplots
- [`import_assoc()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/import_assoc.md)
  : Import association results from STOAT
- [`import_genotype_chunk()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/import_genotype_chunk.md)
  : Import a chunk of the snarl genotypes for a queried region
- [`make_report()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/make_report.md)
  : General a summary report.
- [`manhattan_plot()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/manhattan_plot.md)
  : Manhattan plot with all tested snarls
- [`path_length_distribution()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/path_length_distribution_all.md)
  : Path Length Distribution Plots for STOAT
- [`plot_pvalue_hist()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/plot_pvalue_hist.md)
  : P-value Histogram for STOAT GWAS Results
- [`preprocess_test_table()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/preprocess_test_table.md)
  : Prepare the phenotype/genotype/covariate table before a test
- [`qq_plot()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/qq_plot.md)
  : Q-Q plot of the p-values
- [`snarl_type_histogram()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/snarl_type_histogram.md)
  : Dot Plot of snarl type histogram
- [`summary_stoat()`](https://pa-tou.github.io/stoat_plot/reference/summary_stoat.md)
  : Summary of STOAT's results
